title: Kiloparsec-scale Dust Disks in High-redshift Luminous Submillimeter Galaxies
question: How is the dust-obscured star formation distributed (size, profile, clumpiness) in luminous z~2.5 SMGs at ~1 kpc resolution, and how does it compare with the stellar emission?

what.value: Cycle 0 ALESS 870um flux densities, flux-boost corrected

evidence.quote: The Cycle 0 flux densities were taken from (cite: 2013ApJ...768...91H) and have been corrected for the effect of flux boosting

what.value: LFIR, Tdust, SFR, dust masses and redshifts for SMGs

evidence.loc: 3.4 The L_IR–T relation and gas surface densities
evidence.quote: we have used the $L_{\rm FIR}$ and $T_{\rm dust}$ values reported in (cite: 2014MNRAS.438.1267S)

recipe.method: CASA clean with natural, R=-0.5 and uv-tapered weightings; multi-scale clean
Mask below 2 sigma, sum in aperture of 3 x b_maj, compare with Cycle 0 flux across resolutions
Fit 2D Gaussian and 2D Sérsic in image plane; stack rotated 2 arcsec cutouts
Radially average visibilities in 75 klambda bins; fit Gaussian and Gaussian+constant
Curves of growth in 1.5 arcsec aperture on ALMA and H160 images
Image at R=-0.5, subtract 2D Gaussian, compare with 16 simulated smooth exponential disks
key_parameters: Re=0.26 arcsec, axis ratio 0.5, S870~6.5 mJy

recipe.method: Compare sizes with blackbody Stefan–Boltzmann predictions; convert SED dust mass to gas surface density

answer_key.quantity: Median ALMA half-light radius (curve of growth)

evidence.quote: the median half–light radius of the ALMA 870$\mu$m emission is 0.16$''$$\pm$0.02$''$
the median half–light radius of the *H*$_{\rm 160}$–band imaging is 0.5$''$$\pm$0.1$''$

answer_key.quantity: Median recovered flux fraction, natural weighting

not_stated_but_needed: Which calibrator was used for which role (flux vs phase) is ambiguous in the order given
Fitting software and uncertainty method for the image-plane 2D Gaussian/Sérsic fits
Priors/likelihood and tool for the uv-plane fits
CASA simulation setup (simobserve parameters, noise injection) for disk simulations
Exact SED-derived dust masses and temperatures used for gas surface densities
Whether the ALMA project 2011.0.00294.S Cycle 0 data were re-reduced
missing_for_reproduction: Fitting code and error estimation details
score_reason: Imaging and analysis recipe mostly described but fitting tools and some parameters missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, clear imaging recipe, numeric size/index results.
